case_studies.title: Securing Autonomous Agent Actions
case_studies.challenge: Autonomous multi-agent system was executing privileged tool calls with broad, unisolated database write privileges.

case_studies.strategic_outcome: Cleared enterprise SOC2 Type II audit without high-severity findings, unlocking Fortune 500 financial contracts.

case_studies.title: Inference Unit Economics
case_studies.challenge: Rapid product growth caused cloud inference token burn to erode gross margins from 72% down to 34% within two quarters.
case_studies.advisory_contribution: Structured tiered model routing (small-model task routing + frontier escalation) and semantic embedding caching.
case_studies.strategic_outcome: Reduced annual token spend by 48% , improved p95 response latency by 3x, and restored margins above 70%.
